notes: Canonical ClientFlow 1.3.30 hardening and operator-visibility release. It preserves the 10-second display/browser contracts, fail-closed post-reboot acceptance, outbound-TCP-443 WSS/HTTPS fallback design, deterministic role-scoped health visibility, shared multi-viewer Livestream generation and 30-second Livestream/Remote Desktop warm-grace behaviour. Embedded runtime Python deliberately remains 3.13.14.

This selector authority is intentionally fresh-install-only. The immutable approved bundle advertises in_place_update as a technical bundle capability, but no authentic older physical ClientFlow baseline has proven that path for 1.3.30. Therefore update_allowed is false and in_place_update is absent from catalog install_modes. Do not infer update compatibility from bundle capabilities.

Promoted to fresh-install selection only after exact source 6995280649c68bbd201dee73edde7d6a1f71eaa5 passed CI #1219 / run 37210696042, runtime-input transport #14 / run 37212319478 produced sequence-1231 inputs at SHA-256 14c5fee3193b8a8c93559643afa5bf96de910ca64233e483628aafee643021fb, release-build #35 / run 37230708535 produced byte-identical candidates, approval #18 / run 37267974054 approved candidate 2491c1a15a182e4836b0458e812b304ec7c01d6f897e209b2a49d401930cc8e0, and the exact 224174080-byte approved bundle was transported, immutably published and independently re-read at SHA-256 b3fbe2530907d86e581704a58819c01f17d8ca2f8842a0d2f6e35f9bb9138cd7 before this selector change. Final clean Ubuntu 26.04 fresh-install physical acceptance remains the immediate post-deployment gate.
